title: Ansel and the Visitor
author: Dominic Pemberton
blurb: Theo Eastwick, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
